name: Tire replacement
notes: Inspect regularly, replace as needed - When tread reaches 2/32 inch, damage occurs, or tires age

name: Wheel alignment
notes: As needed - Check annually or when replacing tires, after suspension work, or if pulling/uneven wear occurs

name: Cabin Filter
notes: Scheduled / condition-based - Inspect every 12,000-15,000 miles; often replace around 15,000-30,000 miles

name: Fuel Filter
notes: Often 30,000-60,000 miles if serviceable; some are designed to last much longer or are not separately replaceable

name: Braking Serviced
notes: Inspect about every 5,000-7,500 miles or during tire rotations; replace pads/rotors based on wear

name: Spark Plugs
notes: Commonly 30,000-100,000+ miles depending on plug type and engine

name: Transmission
notes: Manufacturer-dependent , Often 30,000-60,000 miles for severe use; some vehicles specify longer intervals or no routine service under normal use.

name: Wiper Blades
notes: Inspect regularly, replace as needed. When streaking, skipping, or deteriorated

name: Radiator / Cooling System
notes: Inspect coolant, leaks, hoses, and radiator periodically; coolant replacement often every 5 years or 30,000-100,000+ miles depending on coolant and vehicle

name: Belts & Hoses
notes: Inspect at routine services; replace by specified interval if applicable, or when cracked, swollen, frayed, leaking, or worn
